# Leyoxa

> Leyoxa LLC is an AI venture studio. It co-builds vertical AI companies with operators who already have customers: the operator brings customers, industry knowledge and a costly operational problem; Leyoxa brings the engineering, AI systems and security for regulated data, and takes part of its return in equity.

Every page is also published as markdown. Contact: contact@leyoxa.com. Founder: Sepehr Aflatounian (https://sepehrafla.github.io).

## Pages

- [Home](https://leyoxa.com/index.md): What Leyoxa is, how it builds, and its first partnership.
- [Questions about Leyoxa](https://leyoxa.com/faq.md): Answers about Leyoxa, an AI venture studio — what it is, who is a fit, how it is paid, who owns the IP, and how to start a partnership.
- [How an AI venture studio partnership works](https://leyoxa.com/how-it-works.md): How Leyoxa co-builds a vertical AI company with an operator — who is a fit, the five stages, how the economics and IP work, and what we do not do.
- [Praxis: AI agents for dental practices](https://leyoxa.com/praxis.md): How Leyoxa co-built Praxis with a dental marketing company — six AI agents in production, from voice booking to reputation, built for patient data.
